thread:
Jules: Idea: 'delta-confidence gate' for config rollouts. Instead of fixed percent thresholds, use bootstrap CIs on delta metrics and require the CI to exclude harmful regressions. Reduces false positives from noise.

Kavi: Nice. So we'd estimate delta = candidate - baseline and compute 95% CI via resampling? :thinking_face:

Jules: Exactly. Example rule: fail if lower-bound of (error_rate_delta) > 0.002 OR upper-bound of (p95_delta) > 0.04. Otherwise pass. That way a noisy spike that isn't statistically significant won't block.

Marta: Ops questions: 1) how many resamples for bootstrap (1000?), 2) latency of compute for long windows, 3) low-traffic fallbacks. We should limit bootstrap to sampled data and provide a deterministic fallback (percentile delta) when sample_count < min_n.

Kavi: Also need to account for absolute vs relative deltas. For small baselines, relative percent change is unstable. Gate should accept both: absolute_delta_threshold OR relative_ci.

Jules: Agree. For API and CLI, draft example (single-line JSON in chat): POST /api/v1/config/rollout {"change":"flag=adaptive_cache=true","gate":"delta_confidence","metrics":["error_rate","p95_latency"],"ci":0.95,"resamples":500,"min_samples":200,"fallback":"percentile","cooldown":900}

Marta: For Console UX: show small widget: Gate result: PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, delta point estimates + CI bars, sample_count, and a tiny button "View resample seeds" for debugging. Also a replay-preview that runs a 10m historical shadow and returns CI quickly. cap replay to 3h unless you have replay-power.

Kavi: Failure handling: on FAIL -> auto-pause + notify owners + create a draft token (see token flow) with status=failed. After 2 fails require manual review. Provide optional 'auto-rollback' flag but default off.

ops-bot: scheduled sim: job sim-6601 queued (mode=shadow,sample=0.02,resamples=500) expected ~3m.

replay-bot: cheap-preview done: 10m sample returned error_rate_delta mean=0.0008 (95% CI [-0.0005,0.0021]) -> INCONCLUSIVE for CI rule.

Jules: Good data. For telemetry team: we need an aggregation endpoint that returns per-request labels (success/failure, latency) batched for the window to feed bootstrap. BigQuery big windows + Prometheus recent. Propose 'metrics-sample' API that returns sampled rows and counts.

Marta: I'll draft the contract: metrics-sample -> {sample_rows_ref,count,baseline_mean,candidate_mean}. We'll also add ingestion_delay param and mark CI as invalid if data is incomplete.

Kavi: Security/ownership: only config-owner or role 'ci-approver' can override an INCONCLUSIVE result. Overrides must be audited and require a reason.

Jules: Next steps: 1) short RFC with math + edge-cases, 2) telemetry contract for metrics-sample, 3) console mock for CI bars and override flow, 4) implement cheap-preview and hook to replay-bot. Who picks up RFC?

Marta: I'll take RFC and include sample SQL for sampling and pseudocode for bootstrap.

Kavi: I'll prototype the CLI flags and the fallback semantics.

Jules: Thanks. Sync 30m after lunch to review the mock and RFC checklist. :thumbsup:
